detail: Awaiting decision D-107 (proposed). A daily 03:00 job that soft-expires old listings is implemented and evidenced for review
history: Implementation prepared for review in the task PR; the decision that blocks this task is still proposed
limitations: Dependencies of this task were delivered outside the task workflow and are not all recorded as done
Unit tests mock the models; the integration run uses a disposable local MongoDB replica set, not a deployed environment

AC-SYS-04-1.note: The job runs daily at 03:00 local time on listings older than the configured age (tests/cron-service.test.js, tests/order-jobs.test.js, integration section listing-expiry). It sets status expired, the recommended option of D-107, which is still proposed; the open PR #103 proposes the baseline deletion instead
